name: Asana MCP Server
summary: Asana's hosted MCP servers. The vendor documents two endpoints on one hostname: mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp, whose tools reference lists 18 read, 6 write and 3 interactive tools over the Asana Work Graph, and mcp.asana.com/v2/command/mcp for Command Teamspaces, tickets and releases. A beta v1 server at mcp.asana.com/sse is documented as deprecated. Keyless 2026-10-21: every one of those paths answers 401 with an RFC 9728 challenge, in two distinct forms, and the host serves three protected-resource documents naming two different authorization servers.
